meta.editable_note: Lab staff may edit this file. Restart the dev server after changes. Do not put patient data here. Window times and Capillarys zones are teaching defaults, not a local SOP.
meta.thresholds_note: Cut-offs are adult teaching defaults for common HPLC/CE programs. They are not a substitute for the laboratory's own verified reference intervals.
meta.rt_note: VARIANT II / Turbo retention times are close to, but not the same as, the Bio-Rad VARIANT times in Joutovsky 2004. Ranges below are a composite for the β-thalassaemia short program and should be replaced with the local library.
meta.zone_note: Sebia CAPILLARYS HEMOGLOBIN(E) zone numbers differ by software version. The map below follows a widely used teaching chart (Z3 A2, Z4 E, Z5 S, Z9 A, Z12/Z14 Bart's, Z15 H, small Z1–Z2 peaks for Constant Spring–like variants) and must be checked against the insert loaded on the analyser.

sources.citation: Joutovsky A, Hadzi-Nesic J, Nardi MA. HPLC retention time as a diagnostic tool for hemoglobin variants and hemoglobinopathies: a study of 60,000 samples in a clinical diagnostic laboratory. Clin Chem. 2004;50(10):1736-1747. (Bio-Rad VARIANT β-Thalassemia Short Program — not a Variant II validation.)
Bio-Rad VARIANT II / VARIANT II Turbo β-Thalassemia Short Program instruction manual and variant retention library. Windows move with column, reagent lot, and software.
Sebia CAPILLARYS and CAPILLARYS 2 Flex Piercing HEMOGLOBIN(E) package insert and migration-zone chart. Confirm the zone legend on the software version in use.
Bain BJ. Haemoglobinopathy Diagnosis. 2nd ed. Oxford: Wiley-Blackwell; 2006, and later editions.

Traeger-Synodinos J, Harteveld CL, Old JM, et al. EMQN Best Practice Guidelines for molecular and haematology methods for carrier identification and prenatal diagnosis of the haemoglobinopathies. Eur J Hum Genet. 2015;23(4):426-437.

Weatherall DJ, Clegg JB. The Thalassaemia Syndromes. 4th ed. Oxford: Blackwell Science; 2001. Background for Southeast Asian patterns (--SEA, Hb E, Hb Constant Spring, Hb H), not for instrument windows.

examples_en: Hb Constant Spring and other α-chain termination variants (small)
examples_zh: Hb Constant Spring 及其他 α 鏈終止變異（細峰）
百分比高時常見 Hb C

variants.hgvs: many alleles; confirm on IthaGenes / HbVar
variants.hk_note_en: Common in Hong Kong. Uncomplicated trait usually shows a raised Hb A2 and a normal or only mildly raised Hb F, with microcytosis.
variants.hk_note_zh: 香港常見。單純特質通常係 Hb A2 升高，Hb F 正常或輕微升高，兼小球症。
variants.hplc_rt: Hb A2 about 3.6–3.7 min on many β-thal short programs
variants.hplc_en: Hb A2 is often about 4–8%. Iron deficiency can lower A2 into the reference interval. A δ variant can split A2; add the fractions. Hb E, Lepore, and Hb D-Iran share this window — use the percentage and a second method.
variants.hplc_zh: Hb A2 多數大約 4–8%。缺鐵可以將 A2 拉返入參考區間。δ 變異會拆開 A2，要加埋一齊計。Hb E、Lepore、Hb D-Iran 都喺呢個窗——靠百分比同第二種方法分開。
variants.ce_zones: Z3 (Hb A2), separated from Hb E
variants.ce_en: On Capillarys, measure A2 in its own zone. Do not apply an HPLC 'A2 window includes E' rule to a separated CE peak.
variants.ce_zh: Capillarys 可以喺 A2 自己嘅區量度。唔好將 HPLC「A2 窗包含 E」嘅規則套落一條已經分開嘅電泳峰。
pitfalls_en: A single raised A2 is not a genotype.
α-thalassaemia co-inheritance changes red-cell indices and can lower A2.
pitfalls_zh: 單一次 A2 升高不是基因型。
同時有 α-地貧會改變紅血球指數，亦可以降低 A2。
confirm_en: CBC and film
Ferritin or iron studies if A2 is borderline or iron deficiency is possible
CE if the HPLC A2 window is ambiguous
HBB analysis and partner testing when the result is for genetic counselling
confirm_zh: CBC 同血片
A2 喺灰區或可能缺鐵時查鐵蛋白
HPLC 嘅 A2 窗含糊時用毛細管電泳
用於遺傳諮詢時先考慮 HBB 分析同配偶篩查
search_pubmed: beta thalassemia trait HPLC Hb A2
beta thalassaemia trait Capillarys Hb A2

variants.hgvs: --SEA, -α3.7, -α4.2 and non-deletional alleles including Hb Constant Spring
variants.hk_note_en: α0 (--SEA) and α+ deletions are common in southern Chinese populations. Trait is usually invisible on HPLC and CE.
variants.hk_note_zh: 華南人群常見 α0（--SEA）同 α+ 缺失。特質喺 HPLC 同毛細管電泳通常睇唔到異常峰。
variants.hplc_rt: Trait: normal trace. Hb H disease: early / void peak, often underestimated.
variants.hplc_en: A normal chromatogram does not exclude α-thalassaemia trait. Hb H may be absent from the integrated peaks.
variants.hplc_zh: 層析圖正常不能排除 α-地貧特質。Hb H 可能根本冇被積分。
variants.ce_zones: Hb H usually Z15; Bart's usually a fast zone (often Z12 or Z14)
variants.ce_en: Capillarys detects Hb H and Hb Bart's more reliably than the Variant II β-thal short program. Trait still looks normal.
variants.ce_zh: Capillarys 偵測 Hb H 同 Hb Bart's 通常好過 Variant II β-地貧短程式。特質仍然可以完全正常。
pitfalls_en: Gap-PCR for deletions misses Hb Constant Spring and other non-deletional alleles.
pitfalls_zh: 只做缺失嘅 gap-PCR 會漏 Hb Constant Spring 及其他非缺失等位基因。
confirm_en: CBC
Gap-PCR for --SEA, -α3.7, -α4.2
Specific assay or sequencing for Hb CS when a non-deletional allele is possible
confirm_zh: CBC
gap-PCR 檢測 --SEA、-α3.7、-α4.2
懷疑非缺失等位基因時加 CS 專項檢測或測序
search_pubmed: alpha thalassemia Hong Kong SEA deletion HPLC

variants.hgvs: commonly catalogued as HBB:c.79G>A (p.Glu27Lys); confirm on HbVar
variants.hk_note_en: Common in Hong Kong and across Southeast Asia. Heterozygotes are mild; Hb E/β-thalassaemia is clinically important.
variants.hk_note_zh: 香港同東南亞常見。雜合子通常輕微；Hb E／β-地貧臨床上重要。
variants.hplc_rt: Co-elutes with Hb A2, often about 3.6–3.8 min
variants.hplc_en: On the Variant II β-thal short program Hb E and Hb A2 co-elute. About 25–35% in the A2 window with mostly Hb A fits Hb E trait, not 'very high A2' β-thalassaemia. Above ~85% with little A and little F fits Hb EE. A lower E fraction with raised F fits Hb E/β-thalassaemia. These ranges overlap.
variants.hplc_zh: Variant II β-地貧短程式上 Hb E 同 Hb A2 一齊流出。A2 窗大約 25–35% 而主峰仍係 Hb A，先至似 Hb E trait，不是「A2 超高」嘅 β-地貧。高過大約 85%、幾乎冇 A 同 F，先至似 Hb EE。E 較低兼 F 升高，似 Hb E／β-地貧。呢啲範圍會重疊。
variants.ce_zones: Usually Z4, with Hb A2 remaining in Z3
variants.ce_en: Capillarys usually separates Hb E from Hb A2, so a true A2 can be reported. This is the useful cross-check when HPLC shows an A2-window fraction above 10%.
variants.ce_zh: Capillarys 通常將 Hb E 同 Hb A2 分開，所以可以報真正嘅 A2。HPLC 嘅 A2 窗高過 10% 時，呢個係有用嘅對照。
pitfalls_en: Hb D-Iran and Hb Lepore also enter the HPLC A2 window.
Do not separate EE from E/β0 on percentages alone.
Transfused cells imitate mixed patterns.
pitfalls_zh: Hb D-Iran 同 Hb Lepore 都會進入 HPLC 嘅 A2 窗。
不能單靠百分比分開 EE 同 E/β0。
輸血會造成混合圖像。
confirm_en: CE to separate E from A2
CBC (EE is milder than E/β-thalassaemia)
HBB:c.79G>A plus β-thalassaemia allele analysis when the phenotype is unclear
confirm_zh: 用毛細管電泳分開 E 同 A2
CBC（EE 通常輕過 E／β-地貧）
表型唔清楚時檢測 HBB:c.79G>A 以及其他 β-地貧等位基因
search_pubmed: Hb E HPLC Variant II A2 window

variants.hgvs: commonly catalogued as HBA2:c.427T>C (p.Ter143Gln); confirm on HbVar
variants.hk_note_en: The important non-deletional α-thalassaemia allele in the region. Heterozygotes are easy to miss. Hb H/CS disease is more severe than deletional Hb H disease.
variants.hk_note_zh: 區內重要嘅非缺失 α-地貧等位基因。雜合子好易漏。Hb H／CS 病通常重過缺失型 Hb H 病。
variants.hplc_rt: Sometimes a small peak near the C window (~5.0–5.3 min); often absent
variants.hplc_en: The printed percentage (often <2%, or zero) underestimates CS because the variant is unstable. Absence on HPLC does not exclude it.
variants.hplc_zh: 報表上嘅百分比（常常低過 2%，甚至冇）會低估 CS，因為呢種變異唔穩定。HPLC 睇唔到不能排除。
variants.ce_zones: Often a small Z1 or Z2 peak
variants.ce_en: A small early-zone peak is more often visible on Capillarys than on HPLC, but degraded haemoglobin can sit in the same region. Do not call CS from the zone alone.
variants.ce_zh: Capillarys 比 HPLC 更容易見到早期區嘅細峰，但降解血紅蛋白亦可以企喺同一區。不能單靠 zone 叫 CS。
pitfalls_en: Gap-PCR will miss CS.
A small Z1/Z2 peak is not specific.
pitfalls_zh: gap-PCR 會漏 CS。
Z1／Z2 細峰沒有特異性。
confirm_en: CE if only HPLC was done
Supravital stain when Hb H disease is in the differential
A CS-specific molecular assay, not gap-PCR alone
confirm_zh: 如果只做咗 HPLC，加毛細管電泳
鑑別包括 Hb H 病時做超活體染色
做 CS 專項分子檢測，唔好只做 gap-PCR

variants.hgvs: β4 tetramer; genotype is the underlying α genotype, not a single HBB variant
variants.hk_note_en: Hb H disease (--/-α, or --/αTα such as --/αCSα) causes a chronic haemolytic anaemia. The HPLC percentage is not the true amount.
variants.hk_note_zh: Hb H 病（--/−α，或 --／αTα 例如 --／αCSα）會有慢性溶血。HPLC 嘅百分比不是真實分量。
variants.hplc_rt: Very early, often ~0.2–0.6 min, frequently not integrated
variants.hplc_en: Do not exclude Hb H disease because the Variant II chromatogram shows no H peak. A2 is often low.
variants.hplc_zh: Variant II 層析圖冇 H 峰，不能排除 Hb H 病。A2 常常偏低。
variants.ce_en: A peak in the most anodic zone is the usual CE clue. Still confirm with stain and DNA; the zone assignment is software-specific.
variants.ce_zh: 最向陽極嗰區嘅峰係毛細管電泳上常見線索。仍然要用染色同 DNA 確認；zone 視軟件而定。
pitfalls_en: Newborns have Hb Bart's rather than a stable adult Hb H pattern.
Transfusion suppresses the H fraction.
pitfalls_zh: 新生兒見嘅係 Hb Bart's，不是穩定嘅成人 Hb H 模式。
輸血會壓低 H 分畫。
confirm_en: Brilliant cresyl blue or new methylene blue inclusions
CE if HPLC was negative but the CBC fits
α genotyping including non-deletional alleles
confirm_zh: Brilliant cresyl blue 或 new methylene blue 睇 inclusion
CBC 符合但 HPLC 陰性時加毛細管電泳
α 基因分型，包括非缺失等位基因

variants.hgvs: γ4 tetramer; amount in cord blood relates to α-gene deficit but cut-offs are local
variants.hk_note_en: Relevant in newborns and cord blood. It disappears as γ-chain production switches off. Adult traces should not be interpreted with newborn Bart's rules.
variants.hk_note_zh: 主要用於新生兒同臍帶血。γ 鏈生產停止後會消失。成人圖譜不能用新生兒 Bart's 規則。
variants.hplc_en: Report Bart's only with age or a cord-blood label. Do not use the adult A2 cut-off on the same sample.
variants.hplc_zh: 一定要連年齡或臍帶血標籤先報 Bart's。同一樣本不能用成人 A2 切點。
variants.ce_en: Fast-zone Bart's in a newborn is the finding. In an adult a large Z12 peak is more often a fast variant such as Hb J than Bart's.
variants.ce_zh: 新生兒快區嘅 Bart's 先至係重點。成人大幅 Z12 峰多數係 Hb J 這類快變異，不是 Bart's。
pitfalls_en: Bart's percentage cut-offs for the number of α genes deleted are method-specific.
pitfalls_zh: 用 Bart's 百分比估計缺失咗幾多個 α 基因，切點視方法而定。
confirm_en: Confirm age and sample type
Repeat HPLC/CE after 6–12 months before any adult A2 comment
α genotyping if the newborn screen protocol requires it
confirm_zh: 核對年齡同樣本種類
6–12 個月後先再評成人 A2
如果新生兒篩查方案要求，先做 α 基因分型

variants.hgvs: commonly catalogued as HBB:c.20A>T (p.Glu7Val); confirm on HbVar
variants.hk_note_en: Less common than Hb E locally, but transfusion and ancestry make it a routine differential of an S-window peak.
variants.hk_note_zh: 本地少過 Hb E，但輸血同族裔背景令 S 窗嘅峰仍然要常規鑑別。
variants.hplc_en: Trait: A > S, S often ~30–40%, A2 normal. Sickle-cell disease patterns (SS, S/β0) have little or no A; they cannot be separated from each other on one chromatogram. S/β+ has S > A and a raised A2. Hb Q-Thailand often uses this window.
variants.hplc_zh: Trait：A 多過 S，S 常常約 30–40%，A2 正常。鐮刀形血球疾病模式（SS、S/β0）幾乎冇 A，一張圖分唔開佢哋。S/β+ 係 S 多過 A 兼 A2 升高。Hb Q-Thailand 常常都喺呢個窗。
variants.ce_en: Confirm with a second method. Solubility testing is only an adjunct and does not genotype.
variants.ce_zh: 要用第二種方法確認。溶解度試驗只係輔助，不能定基因型。
pitfalls_en: A printed 'S-window' label is not the same as a named Hb S peak.
Recent transfusion creates mixed A and S fractions.
pitfalls_zh: 報表寫「S 窗」不等於已經命名為 Hb S。
近期輸血會造成 A 同 S 混合。
confirm_en: Second method (CE or acid/alkaline electrophoresis)
Solubility test as an adjunct only
HBB analysis when the clinical or antenatal question needs a genotype
confirm_zh: 第二種方法（毛細管電泳或酸／鹼電泳）
溶解度試驗只作輔助
臨床或產前問題需要基因型時先做 HBB 分析
search_pubmed: Hb S HPLC retention time Variant

variants.hgvs: commonly catalogued as HBB:c.19G>A (p.Glu7Lys); confirm on HbVar
variants.hk_note_en: Uncommon in Hong Kong. A C-window peak still needs Hb O-Arab in the differential.
variants.hk_note_zh: 香港少見。C 窗嘅峰仍然要將 Hb O-Arab 列入鑑別。
variants.hplc_en: Trait is roughly 30–45%. A peak under about 5% in this window is not Hb C trait; consider Hb Constant Spring or noise.
variants.hplc_zh: Trait 大約 30–45%。呢個窗低過大約 5% 不是 Hb C trait；要考慮 Hb Constant Spring 或雜訊。
variants.ce_zones: Often Z2 when the fraction is substantial
variants.ce_en: A small Z2 peak is the CS region in this app's teaching map, not Hb C.
variants.ce_zh: 喺本程式嘅教學地圖入面，Z2 細峰屬 CS 區域，不是 Hb C。
pitfalls_en: Hb O-Arab co-elutes near Hb C on many HPLC programs.
pitfalls_zh: 好多 HPLC 程式上 Hb O-Arab 同 Hb C 接近或重疊。
confirm_en: Second method
DNA if ancestry or antenatal care makes the distinction matter
confirm_zh: 第二種方法
如果族裔或產前檢查需要區分，先做 DNA

variants.hgvs: commonly catalogued as HBB:c.364G>C (p.Glu122Gln); confirm on HbVar
variants.hk_note_en: The usual clinically significant Hb D. Heterozygotes are benign. D-window peaks include α variants such as Hb G-Philadelphia, which have a lower fraction.
variants.hk_note_zh: 臨床上最常講嘅 Hb D。雜合子通常良性。D 窗亦包括 Hb G-Philadelphia 呢類 α 變異，百分比會低啲。
variants.hplc_rt: Often about 4.0–4.2 min, before Hb S
variants.hplc_en: Does not give a positive sickle solubility test. Separating D-Punjab from G-Philadelphia needs percentage, CE, and often DNA.
variants.hplc_zh: 鐮刀溶解度試驗係陰性。要分開 D-Punjab 同 G-Philadelphia，要睇百分比、毛細管電泳，很多時要 DNA。
variants.ce_en: Lepore can sit near this region on some charts. Read the local zone legend.
variants.ce_zh: 部分圖表上 Lepore 會靠近呢區。要睇實驗室自己嘅 zone 圖例。
pitfalls_en: Do not call every D-window peak Hb D-Punjab.
pitfalls_zh: 唔好將每一個 D 窗嘅峰都叫成 Hb D-Punjab。
confirm_en: CE or electrophoresis
Solubility test only to show it is not Hb S
DNA if a name is required on a report
confirm_zh: 毛細管電泳或傳統電泳
溶解度試驗只用於顯示佢不是 Hb S
報告需要命名時先做 DNA

variants.hgvs: commonly catalogued as HBB:c.364G>A (p.Glu122Lys); confirm on HbVar
variants.hk_note_en: Uncommon locally. Included because it occupies the HPLC C window and is mistaken for Hb C.
variants.hk_note_zh: 本地少見。列入係因為佢企喺 HPLC 嘅 C 窗，會被當成 Hb C。
variants.hplc_rt: Often slightly faster than or with Hb C, about 4.9–5.2 min
variants.hplc_en: Percentage in heterozygotes resembles Hb C trait. HPLC alone should be reported as a C-window variant until a second method or DNA separates them.
variants.hplc_zh: 雜合子百分比似 Hb C trait。在第二種方法或 DNA 分開之前，HPLC 只應報成 C 窗變異。
variants.ce_zones: Software-dependent, often near S/C rather than a tiny Z1 peak
variants.ce_en: Use the zone chart for the installed Sebia software rather than this teaching default.
variants.ce_zh: 用部機安裝嘅 Sebia 軟件圖例，唔好只靠呢份教學預設。
pitfalls_en: Compound heterozygosity with Hb S is clinically significant and looks nothing like trait.
pitfalls_zh: 同 Hb S 嘅複合雜合子有臨床意義，圖像不會似 trait。
confirm_en: Electrophoresis or CE
DNA when C versus O-Arab changes care
confirm_zh: 電泳或毛細管電泳
如果 C 同 O-Arab 會改變處理，先做 DNA

variants.hgvs: δβ fusion; Lepore-Boston-Washington is the usual allele — confirm on HbVar
variants.hk_note_en: Uncommon compared with β-thalassaemia trait, but it is the classic trap in the A2 window because the fraction is often only 5–15%.
variants.hk_note_zh: 比起 β-地貧特質少見，但係 A2 窗嘅經典陷阱，因為分畫常常只有 5–15%。
variants.hplc_rt: With or just before Hb A2
variants.hplc_en: The A2 window total can look like β-thalassaemia trait or sit a little higher. CE usually pulls Lepore away from A2. Suspect Lepore when the 'A2' is atypical, indices are thalassaemic, and CE does not show Hb E.
variants.hplc_zh: A2 窗總量可以似 β-地貧特質，或者再高少少。毛細管電泳通常將 Lepore 拉離 A2。如果「A2」不典型、指數似地貧、而電泳又唔係 Hb E，要懷疑 Lepore。
variants.ce_zones: Often near Z6–Z7, separated from A2 (Z3) and E (Z4)
variants.ce_en: Separation from A2 is the practical reason to run CE.
variants.ce_zh: 同 A2 分開，就係要加做毛細管電泳嘅實際原因。
pitfalls_en: In Hong Kong a 4–8% A2 peak is still far more often β-thalassaemia trait than Lepore. Lepore stays on the differential list.
pitfalls_zh: 喺香港，4–8% 嘅 A2 峰仍然多數係 β-地貧特質，多過 Lepore。Lepore 留喺鑑別名單就得。
confirm_en: CE
HBB/HBD fusion testing if CE is not β-thalassaemia trait and not Hb E
confirm_zh: 毛細管電泳
如果電泳既不是 β-地貧特質亦不是 Hb E，考慮 HBB／HBD 融合檢測

variants.hgvs: β22 Glu→Gln; confirm the HGVS entry on HbVar before reporting
variants.hk_note_en: Included as an A2-window look-alike of Hb E. Heterozygous fraction is nearer a β-variant (~30–40%) than a β-trait A2.
variants.hk_note_zh: 列入係因為佢喺 A2 窗會扮成 Hb E。雜合子分畫接近 β 變異（約 30–40%），不是 β-地貧特質嗰種 A2。
variants.hplc_en: HPLC cannot separate Hb D-Iran from Hb E. CE and DNA can.
variants.hplc_zh: HPLC 分唔開 Hb D-Iran 同 Hb E。毛細管電泳同 DNA 可以。
variants.ce_zones: Does not co-migrate with Hb A2 on Capillarys (confirm locally)
variants.ce_en: If CE shows a separated E-zone peak, Hb E is more likely than D-Iran in this region; DNA still names the allele.
variants.ce_zh: 如果毛細管電泳見到獨立 E 區峰，喺本地區 Hb E 比 D-Iran 更常見；要命名仍靠 DNA。
pitfalls_en: Do not report Hb E from HPLC alone when the clinical question needs the allele name.
pitfalls_zh: 如果臨床問題需要等位基因名稱，唔好只靠 HPLC 報 Hb E。
confirm_en: CE
HBB sequencing or a targeted panel
confirm_zh: 毛細管電泳
HBB 測序或靶向 panel

variants.hgvs: commonly catalogued as HBB:c.410G>A (p.Gly137Asp); confirm on HbVar
variants.hk_note_en: An anodic β variant. On HPLC it often falls in the P2 window and can be misread as a glycated fraction if the percentage is ignored.
variants.hk_note_zh: 向陽極嘅 β 變異。HPLC 上常常落入 P2 窗，如果唔睇百分比，會被當成糖化分畫。
variants.hplc_en: A P2 fraction of only a few percent is normal glycation. A large P2 peak (well above 15%) is a variant until proven otherwise; Hb Hope is the usual named example, not the only one.
variants.hplc_zh: P2 只有幾個百分點係正常糖化。P2 大峰（明顯高過 15%）在排除之前都係變異；Hb Hope 係常見命名例子，不是唯一。
variants.ce_zones: Anodic to Hb A, often around Z10
variants.ce_en: Migration anodic to A separates it from a glycated HPLC peak.
variants.ce_zh: 泳向 A 嘅陽極側，就可以同 HPLC 嘅糖化峰分開。
pitfalls_en: Do not call Hb Hope just because P2 is slightly high.
pitfalls_zh: P2 輕微偏高就唔好叫 Hb Hope。
confirm_en: CE
DNA if the peak must be named
confirm_zh: 毛細管電泳
如果一定要命名，先做 DNA

variants.hgvs: commonly catalogued as HBB:c.170G>A (p.Gly57Asp); confirm on HbVar
variants.hk_note_en: A fast β variant seen in Thai and Chinese populations. Heterozygotes are clinically silent. The fraction is large, unlike Hb Bart's in an adult.
variants.hk_note_zh: 泰國同華人族群可見嘅快 β 變異。雜合子通常無症狀。分畫大，同成人嘅 Hb Bart's 唔同。
variants.hplc_en: A large early peak is a fast variant. Hb J-Bangkok is a regional example; other J haemoglobins share the behaviour.
variants.hplc_zh: 大幅早期峰屬於快變異。Hb J-Bangkok 係區內例子；其他 J 血紅蛋白行為相似。
variants.ce_zones: Anodic, often around Z12 in adults
variants.ce_en: Do not call an adult Z12 peak of ~40% Hb Bart's.
variants.ce_zh: 成人約 40% 嘅 Z12 峰唔好叫成 Hb Bart's。
pitfalls_en: Newborn fast peaks are Bart's until age is checked.
pitfalls_zh: 新生兒嘅快峰在核對年齡之前都當 Bart's 處理。
confirm_en: CE
DNA only if a formal name is needed
confirm_zh: 毛細管電泳
只有需要正式名稱時先做 DNA

variants.hgvs: commonly catalogued as HBA1:c.223G>C (p.Asp75His); confirm on HbVar
variants.hk_note_en: An α variant that often elutes in the S window. The fraction is lower than Hb S trait when only one α gene carries it, and it is linked to α-thalassaemia (--SEA / αQα) in Hb QH disease.
variants.hk_note_zh: α 變異，常常喺 S 窗流出。如果只有一條 α 基因帶佢，百分比低過 Hb S trait。同 α-地貧一齊（--SEA／αQα）就係 Hb QH 病。
variants.hplc_en: An unnamed S-window peak in a Southeast Asian sample is not automatically Hb S. Percentage, solubility, and CE separate Q from S more safely than the window name.
variants.hplc_zh: 東南亞樣本一個未命名嘅 S 窗峰，不會自動等於 Hb S。百分比、溶解度同毛細管電泳，都比窗嘅名稱更安全。
variants.ce_en: Pair with α genotyping if indices suggest Hb QH disease.
variants.ce_zh: 如果指數似 Hb QH 病，要加 α 基因分型。
pitfalls_en: A positive sickle screen should not be assumed from the window name.
pitfalls_zh: 唔好由窗嘅名稱假設鐮刀篩查係陽性。
confirm_en: Solubility test (Q is negative)
CE
α genotyping including --SEA when the CBC looks like Hb H disease
confirm_zh: 溶解度試驗（Q 係陰性）
毛細管電泳
CBC 似 Hb H 病時做包括 --SEA 嘅 α 基因分型

variants.hk_note_en: Heterozygotes have raised Hb F (often roughly 5–20%), normal or low A2, and thalassaemic indices. HPFH is the main differential.
variants.hk_note_zh: 雜合子 Hb F 升高（常常大約 5–20%），A2 正常或偏低，指數似地貧。主要鑑別係 HPFH。
variants.hplc_en: Raised F with a raised A2 is not the δβ pattern; think of β-thalassaemia alleles that also raise F.
variants.hplc_zh: F 同 A2 一齊升不是 δβ 模式；要考慮同時升高 F 嘅 β-地貧等位基因。
variants.ce_zones: Hb F zone (often Z8), A2 not increased
variants.ce_en: Distribution of F (heterocellular versus pancellular) needs Kleihauer or flow; HPLC cannot show that.
variants.ce_zh: F 嘅分佈（異細胞 vs 全細胞）要 Kleihauer 或 flow；HPLC 睇唔到。
pitfalls_en: Pregnancy, marrow stress, and hydroxyurea also raise Hb F.
pitfalls_zh: 懷孕、骨髓壓力同 hydroxyurea 都會升高 Hb F。
confirm_en: Kleihauer or flow cytometry
DNA for δβ deletion versus HPFH when counselling depends on it
confirm_zh: Kleihauer 或 flow cytometry
如果諮詢需要區分，先做 δβ 缺失對 HPFH 嘅 DNA
search_pubmed: delta beta thalassemia HPLC Hb F

variants.name_zh: 遺傳性胎兒血紅蛋白持續症
variants.hgvs: deletional and non-deletional HPFH; confirm on IthaGenes
variants.hk_note_en: Heterozygotes often have higher Hb F than δβ trait and near-normal indices, with pancellular F. Overlap with δβ-thalassaemia is wide.
variants.hk_note_zh: 雜合子嘅 Hb F 常常高過 δβ 特質，指數近乎正常，F 呈全細胞分佈。同 δβ-地貧嘅重疊範圍好闊。
variants.hplc_en: F of about 15–30% with normal A2 is compatible with heterozygous HPFH and also with other causes of raised F. This app will not choose between them.
variants.hplc_zh: F 大約 15–30% 而 A2 正常，可以係雜合 HPFH，亦可以係其他升高 F 嘅原因。本程式不會喺兩者之間揀一個當答案。
variants.ce_en: Same limitation as HPLC: quantity is not a genotype.
variants.ce_zh: 同 HPLC 一樣：數量不是基因型。
pitfalls_en: Do not label HPFH from F% alone.
pitfalls_zh: 唔好只靠 F% 寫成 HPFH。
confirm_en: Red-cell indices
Kleihauer or flow
DNA if the distinction from δβ-thalassaemia matters
confirm_zh: 紅血球指數
Kleihauer 或 flow
如果要同 δβ-地貧分開，先做 DNA
